title: Mediterranean Meat Bowl
description: A flavorful and nutritious bowl filled with Mediterranean-style meat, vegetables, and quinoa. Perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the lamb, quinoa, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, red onion, olive oil, lemon juice, and salt. Mix well.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the lamb is cooked through.
While the lamb is cooking, prepare the yogurt sauce by mixing together the Greek yogurt and lemon juice.
To assemble the bowls, place a scoop of the cooked lamb mixture onto a plate, followed by a dollop of the yogurt sauce and a sprinkle of fresh parsley.
Garnish with additional parsley, if desired.
Note: You can also serve this dish as a salad, without cooking the lamb.
Make sure to cook the lamb to an internal temperature of 160°F (71°C) to ensure food safety.
